name: Amitriptyline
effects: Reduces depressive symptoms and used off-label for neuropathic pain, migraine prophylaxis, insomnia
Strong anticholinergic effects: dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision, cognitive impairment
Sedation (strong H1 antagonism) — often used at low dose for insomnia
QTc prolongation — cardiac monitoring warranted at higher doses
Cardiotoxic in overdose — narrow therapeutic index (avoid in patients with cardiac disease)
Serious potential lethality in overdose (seized in toxicology as high-risk TCA)
